# right ascension

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:rightAscension`](gmeow-rightAscension.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/rightAscension>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

Right ascension in degrees (0–360). Frame-relative: the meaning depends on the [`coordinateFrame`](gmeow-coordinateFrame.md) (ICRS, FK5, etc.).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for right ascension in degrees on a [`CelestialCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialCoordinates.md) value; frame-relative.

### Avoid when

- Avoid stating it without [`gmeow:coordinateFrame`](gmeow-coordinateFrame.md) and avoid for terrestrial longitude ([`gmeow:longitude`](gmeow-longitude.md)).

### How to use

- Pair [`gmeow:rightAscension`](gmeow-rightAscension.md) with [`gmeow:declination`](gmeow-declination.md) and a declared [`gmeow:coordinateFrame`](gmeow-coordinateFrame.md) ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).
